items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, and he had the Joe Robichaud.

ctx.x: Who did Lee have with him?

Have a pretty good band? Oh yeah, yeah, good one. Yeah, George Washington on trombone, Pedro Poenelle on alto, David Jones on tenor-sikes, Daniel Parker on guitar, he had Albert Morgan on bass, and I think it was Roy on the drums though. I don't remember the drum player, but he had a good band. Regular New Orleans? Yeah, and he had the Joe Robichaud.
Regular New Orleans band though up there, huh?

items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Yeah. I forgot to ask him. Yeah, she gave Kid Howard some.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played bass drum in the brass bands. He was a left-handed, is that right? Left-handed violin player, and then he was a pretty good writer too. Yes, Mr. Very nice writer. In fact, I have a lot of his books here, what my aunt gave me, and music, they wanted to give me a lot of music, but I had, at that time I had more music than I could handle myself. So finally she gave something to different people, Peter Bocard and the library and most of it, to Dave Frank.
I believe somebody said, Kid Howard may have some of it, do you know?
Yeah. I forgot to ask him. Yeah, she gave Kid Howard some. Kid Howard had quite a bit too. And Dave Frank, he had a library and he had it that...
